name: Welsh Ornithological Society Project Grants
summary: Small grants for projects that benefit birds in Wales, with priority for red and amber listed species. Paid in two halves, with two application rounds a year.

amount.note: Up to £1,000 stated for 2025; more in exceptional circumstances

reporting: Half of the grant is paid on receipt of a report on the work.

eligibility.rule: Study is mostly carried out in Wales
Lead applicant is a WOS member, affiliated-group member, or signs up for membership
Project funds are used only for materials and/or travel expenses, not salaries

documents: Evidence of landowner consent, if applicant does not own the land

calls.label: Two rounds a year
calls.recurring: Applications due 30 June and 31 December each year

status.quote: Each year will have two application rounds: 30th June and 31st December

recurring.quote: Each year will have two application rounds: 30th June and 31st December

geography.quote: towards projects that will be of benefit to birds in Wales

access.quote: Your application must then be made using the application form

eligibility.quote: Study to mostly be carried out in Wales.
Lead applicant is a WOS member or member of WOS Affiliated Group - if not, they will need to sign up for membership

after_award.quote: You will be required to complete an End of Project Report on a form which will be sent to you within 4 weeks of this finish date.
